index_redundancy_audit.scope: Live DISTINCT pg_index indexes in public/private; method, key, opclass, collation, options, predicate, expression, uniqueness, constraints
index_redundancy_audit.initial_false_positive: JOIN pg_constraint ON conindid multiplies index rows when one index backs several foreign keys. Corrected by aggregating constraints per DISTINCT indexrelid; false duplicates are not database defects.

prefix_pairs.shorter_definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX account_preferences_pkey ON public.account_preferences USING btree (owner_id)
prefix_pairs.longer_definition: CREATE INDEX account_active_setup_idx ON public.account_preferences USING btree (owner_id, active_setup_id)
prefix_pairs.disposition: RETAIN: required PK and distinct multi-key read path

prefix_pairs.shorter_definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX recipe_preferences_pkey ON public.recipe_preferences USING btree (owner_id, setup_id, setup_version_id, library_entry_id, style)
prefix_pairs.longer_definition: CREATE INDEX preferred_example_idx ON public.recipe_preferences USING btree (owner_id, setup_id, setup_version_id, library_entry_id, style, favorite_shot_id)
prefix_pairs.disposition: RETAIN: primary key and separately scanned extended-key index

prefix_pairs.shorter_definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX setups_owner_id_id_key ON public.setups USING btree (owner_id, id)
prefix_pairs.longer_definition: CREATE INDEX setup_active_version_idx ON public.setups USING btree (owner_id, id, active_version_id)
prefix_pairs.disposition: RETAIN: explicit UNIQUE plus 4 FK relationships and observed extended-key access

index_redundancy_audit.caveat: Zero-scan statistics, small sizes, and similar leading keys alone cannot prove no consumers. No DDL/drop or migration justified. Prior index full-source coverage not double counted.
